processing_run_bounds.value: "dms"."processing_run"."number">0 AND "dms"."processing_run"."lifecycle_generation" BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483646 AND "dms"."processing_run"."profile" IN ('searchable','structured') AND "dms"."processing_run"."source_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "dms"."processing_run"."state" IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL','FAILED','UNSUPPORTED','CANCELLED') AND "dms"."processing_run"."actor_kind" IN ('machine','operator','coordinator') AND length("dms"."processing_run"."actor_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND ("dms"."processing_run"."key_hash" IS NULL OR "dms"."processing_run"."key_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') AND ("dms"."processing_run"."request_hash" IS NULL OR "dms"."processing_run"."request_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') AND (NOT "dms"."processing_run"."active" OR ("dms"."processing_run"."accepted_stage_id" IS NOT NULL AND "dms"."processing_run"."state" IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL')))

search_chunk_bounds.name: search_chunk_bounds
search_chunk_bounds.value: "dms"."search_chunk"."ordinal" BETWEEN 0 AND 8191 AND char_length("dms"."search_chunk"."text") BETWEEN 1 AND 4096 AND octet_length("dms"."search_chunk"."source"::text)<=4096 AND char_length("dms"."search_chunk"."unit_id")<=160

operator_read.name: operator_read
operator_read.using: tenant_id=nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id',true),'')::uuid AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dms.operator_authorization o WHERE o.tenant_id=service_observation.tenant_id AND o.subject_id=current_setting('app.actor_id',true) AND o.revoked_at IS NULL)

service_observation_bounds.name: service_observation_bounds
service_observation_bounds.value: "dms"."service_observation"."component" IN ('coordinator','publisher','scanner','extractor','heavy','backup') AND "dms"."service_observation"."state" IN ('ready','degraded','stopping') AND "dms"."service_observation"."failures">=0 AND ("dms"."service_observation"."evidence_hash" IS NULL OR "dms"."service_observation"."evidence_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') AND (("dms"."service_observation"."component" IN ('coordinator','backup'))=("dms"."service_observation"."identity_id" IS NULL))
